claim_boundary: This is an exploratory cross-laboratory benchmark of source-local protein-corona rank recovery from protein sequence descriptors. It cannot establish a material-design, clinical, causal, evaluator-independent or external-reproduction claim by itself.

feature_policy.feature_standardization: fit mean and standard deviation on each inner-training partition only

inner_selection.tie_breaker: smaller regularization then lexical model identifier

secondary: mean measurement-batch root mean square error

missingness.author_explicit_zero: retain and exclude from rank target; never impute
missingness.author_na: retain and exclude from rank target; never impute
missingness.source_blank: retain and exclude from rank target; never impute

multiplicity.family: three outer folds by three predeclared models for primary metric comparisons

negative_controls.provenance_feature_leakage: static feature-manifest rejection; no source identity model is fit

outer_evaluation.predeclared_external_ood_lab_anchor: University of Oklahoma Health Sciences Center
outer_evaluation.primary_aggregation: equal-weight mean of measurement-batch metrics within each held-out laboratory anchor

prohibited_actions: use source, laboratory, facility, paper, worksheet, path, cell coordinate or protein identity as a predictive feature
fit or select against any held-out laboratory anchor before its outer-fold evaluation
concatenate raw LFQ, intensity, PSM, spectral-count or normalized-abundance scales across studies
impute zero, blank, NA or omitted protein records as a target rank
claim material-property prediction, clinical utility, causal mechanism or independent external reproduction from this benchmark alone

uncertainty.method: held-out-laboratory measurement-batch cluster bootstrap percentile interval
uncertainty.reporting: report fold-specific point estimates and 95% intervals; do not treat three laboratory anchors as a large-sample confirmatory population
